Name: Selkie Farm Animals
Author: BlueGatorade07
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds selkies as a farm animal, with a (probably unbalanced) content pack for Animal Husbandry Mod. They live in a barn, and once they get to full hearts, they drop their seal skin. Unique textures for male and female selkies, and 4 hair color variations. Hair color can be changed with Alternative Textures. Also adds 2 tailoring recipes using seal skin.[/color][/size]

[b][i][u]No selkies were harmed in the making of this mod. They choose to stay on your farm because they get free food and protection from predators.[/u][/i][/b]

[spoiler][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Basic produce
Tuna
Crab
Octopus

Deluxe produce

Fairy rose (fall only)
Seal skin[/color][/size][/spoiler]

cloth and seal skin

Selkie jacket and seal skin. You keep the jacket[/color][/size][/spoiler]

[spoiler]Give treat every 4 days

No known compatibility issues

[size=4][b]Future plans[/b][/size]
None

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
1.5 (Optional) download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] 
2. Download the mod
3. Unzip into your mods folder
4. Run the game
